children: Andrew Brandt said the Brewers and Rays reaching the World Series despite ranking 19th and 26th in payroll, respectively, shows that strong management, scouting and player development can compete with high spending, according to Bloomberg.

He called the matchup evidence for the players’ union that teams can succeed without a salary cap, while cautioning that owners may view it as an unsustainable exception. Smaller-market teams have little margin for error and can lose players to wealthier clubs in free agency. Brandt spoke with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.”

title: Andrew Brandt Says Brewers-Rays World Series Supports MLB Players’ Case Against Salary Cap
